title: Vectors: ID Context handling
description: Implement and cross-validate OSCORE ID Context handling, including a bounded public Zephyr context-creation/configuration API that derives sender/recipient keys and Common IV with id_context, emits/parses KID Context, and consumes RFC 8613 Appendix C.3/C.6 from test/vectors/oscore.json across C/Python/Rust.
notes: Implemented bounded public oscore_ctx_create_with_id_context() with NULL=absent vs non-NULL+zero=present-empty semantics; ID Context now participates in RFC8613 HKDF info for sender/recipient keys and Common IV, is emitted in request KID Context, and is bound exactly during request unprotect. Added exact Appendix C.3/C.6 protect+unprotect vectors plus NULL/oversize/present-empty/fail-before-output tests. Validation 2026-08-27: Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 OSCORE suite PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL, 38/38 (oscore_ctx 17, oscore_vectors 7, rfc8613_vectors 14); Python uv pytest tests/crypto/test_oscore_vectors.py -q: 38 passed; Rust cargo test -p lichen-oscore --test vectors with isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR: 13 passed; incremental Zephyr rebuild and git diff --check passed.
close_reason: Implemented and cross-validated RFC 8613 ID Context derivation and KID Context handling
